name: semver
prompt:
Explain what this Renyi program does in at most three sentences, for a reader who will decide whether to use it. Do not quote code.

module semver
  purpose: Parse, print and compare semantic version numbers such as 1.4.2.

public type Part is Integer where value is at least 0
  purpose: One numeric component of a version.

public type Version
  purpose: A semantic version without pre-release or build parts.
  has major: Part
  has minor: Part
  has patch: Part
  can Compare by major, minor, patch
end

ability ToText for Version
  function to_text(self) returns Text
    return "{self.major}.{self.minor}.{self.patch}"
  end
end

public type VersionError is one of
  purpose: Why a text is not a version.
  WrongPartCount(input: Text, found: Integer)
  NotANumber(input: Text, part: Text)
end

public function parse(input: Text) returns Version or fails with VersionError
  purpose: Read "major.minor.patch" into a version.
  tags: semver, parsing
  example: parse("1.4.2") is Version(major: 1, minor: 4, patch: 2)
  example: parse("1.4") fails with WrongPartCount(input: "1.4", found: 2)
  example: parse("1.x.2") fails with NotANumber(input: "1.x.2", part: "x")

  let parts be input.trim().split(".")
  if parts.length() is not 3 then fail with WrongPartCount(input: input, found: parts.length()) end
  let major be number_at(parts: parts, index: 0, input: input) otherwise fail
  let minor be number_at(parts: parts, index: 1, input: input) otherwise fail
  let patch be number_at(parts: parts, index: 2, input: input) otherwise fail
  return Version(major: major, minor: minor, patch: patch)
end

function number_at(parts: List of Text, index: Integer, input: Text)
  returns Part
  or fails with VersionError

  let part be parts.at(index)
    otherwise fail with WrongPartCount(input: input, found: parts.length())
  let number be part.to_integer() otherwise fail with NotANumber(input: input, part: part)
  return Part(number) otherwise fail with NotANumber(input: input, part: part)
end

public function satisfies(candidate: Version, required: Version) returns Boolean
  purpose: Whether the candidate can stand in for the required version: same major and not older.
  example: satisfies(
    candidate: Version(major: 1, minor: 5, patch: 0),
    required: Version(major: 1, minor: 4, patch: 2)
  ) is true
  example: satisfies(
    candidate: Version(major: 2, minor: 0, patch: 0),
    required: Version(major: 1, minor: 4, patch: 2)
  ) is false

  return candidate.major is required.major and candidate is at least required
end

public function latest(versions: List of Version) returns maybe Version
  purpose: The greatest version in the list, or nothing for an empty list.
  example: latest([]) is nothing

  return for each version in versions sorted by version descending first
end

test "a version prints as three numbers separated by dots"
  check Version(major: 1, minor: 4, patch: 2).to_text() is "1.4.2"
end

test "versions compare by major, then minor, then patch"
  let older be parse("1.9.9") otherwise fail
  let newer be parse("2.0.0") otherwise fail
  check older is less than newer
  check latest([older, newer]) is newer
end
